text:
cassie: noticed spikes in the Cost Overview today. cache savings are showing up as a single model-level number with no route provenance. saw it during quota review for tenant BetaInc.

tom: can you paste the quick sanity query and a sample ledger row? suspect the billing key canonicalization rolled route into a blob.

cassie: quick query I ran:
```
SELECT tenant_id, route_id, model_sku, SUM(cache_saved_tokens) saved
FROM token_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '6 hours' AND tenant_id = 'beta'
GROUP BY tenant_id, route_id, model_sku
ORDER BY saved DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
rows show three routes with savings but dashboard shows only model-level 300k and no route breakdown.

harpreet: we deliberately collapsed billing dimensions to reduce cardinality last sprint; looks like route_id ended up only in the metadata blob for some events. aggregator groups by billing_key scalar, which explains the lumping.

cassie: product ask: can we add an "explainability" pill on the cost card showing provenance: Observed (raw ledger sum), Attributed (best-effort split), and Attribution Reason (ROUTE, MODEL_FALLBACK, SAMPLED_ESTIMATE). helpful for support when numbers shift.

tom: backend plan: change normalizer to emit explicit route_id + model_sku columns into token_ledger. aggregator will compute both Observed and Attributed. implement server-side top-N route bucketing (N=5) and bucket rest as "other" to guard cardinality. gate this behind feature flag `console.costs.explainability` default off.

harpreet: sampling complicates attribution. solution: emit sample_weight = 1/sampling_rate for sampled events and let aggregator compute upscaled estimates, capped at 100x. also emit attribution_confidence score based on sampling + unique_route_cardinality.

ui-bot: UI note: we'll render a small three-column card: Observed | Attributed | Confidence. Confidence will be High/Med/Low with hover text explaining calculation and a link to docs. top-5 routes shown when flagged on.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy for ingest-normalizer started @ 2026-04-12T22:10:00Z

tom: migration/backfill: backfill attributed_route for last 7 days into a shadow table so the toggle can compare legacy vs new numbers. backfill runs low-priority and emits progress metrics.

cassie: tests: add unit tests for aggregator splitting two events with same model_sku but different route_id and sampling weight tests. integration: simulate 1/10 sampling and ensure upscaled totals within 5% of golden baseline.

harpreet: operational guardrails: add an alert when any tenant sees >20% delta between legacy vs attributed totals in a 1h window post-rollout. auto-rollback flag for that tenant if triggered.

cassie: thanks. I'll file the PR with normalizer + migration + feature flag and attach UI mocks. will enable flag in staging for 24h canary first and post results here.

tom: nice. when PR is up ping me and I'll run the cost-e2e harness.
